```{=html}
<div id="standardized-regression-demo" class="standardized-regression-demo">
  <div class="variance-controls standardized-controls">
    <label class="variance-control">
      <span class="math inline">\(\bar{x}\)</span>
      <input data-param="meanX" type="range" min="-3" max="3" step="0.1" value="0">
      <output data-value="meanX"></output>
    </label>
    <label class="variance-control">
      <span class="math inline">\(\bar{y}\)</span>
      <input data-param="meanY" type="range" min="-3" max="3" step="0.1" value="0">
      <output data-value="meanY"></output>
    </label>
    <label class="variance-control">
      <span class="math inline">\(s_x\)</span>
      <input data-param="sdX" type="range" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1" value="3">
      <output data-value="sdX"></output>
    </label>
    <label class="variance-control">
      <span class="math inline">\(s_y\)</span>
      <input data-param="sdY" type="range" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.1" value="3">
      <output data-value="sdY"></output>
    </label>
    <label class="variance-control">
      <span>Correlation r</span>
      <input data-param="r" type="range" min="-1" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.6">
      <output data-value="r"></output>
    </label>
  </div>
  <div class="standardized-results" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
    <div class="standardized-coefficients">
      <div><span>Intercept a</span><strong data-result="a"></strong></div>
      <div><span>Slope b</span><strong data-result="b"></strong></div>
    </div>
    <div class="standardized-shared-result"><span>R² = r²</span><strong data-result="r2"></strong></div>
    <div class="standardized-coefficients">
      <div><span>Std. intercept</span><strong data-result="aStd"></strong></div>
      <div><span>Std. slope</span><strong data-result="bStd"></strong></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="standardized-plots">
    <svg data-plot="original"></svg>
    <svg data-plot="standardized"></svg>
  </div>
  <p class="standardized-note">Both panels show the same 50 observations</p>
</div>
<script>
standardizedRegressionDemo("#standardized-regression-demo");
</script>
```
